title: Topic 16
japanese_text:
A：この間東京に行ったときにアプリ使って<u>経路</u>を調べたら、変なところを通らされてさ。
B：あー、アプリってたまに変なところに連れて行くよね。
A：そうそう。現地に着くまで<u>治安</u>の悪そうな<u>路地</u>ばかり通らされるからドキドキしたよ。
english_translation: A: When I was in Tokyo the other day, I used an app to search for a route and it took me through somewhere strange. B: Ah, apps sometimes take you to strange places, don't they? A: Yes. I was pretty nervous because it took me through a lot of alleys that didn't seem safe until I reached my destination.
